title: Mondial Relay pickup
summary: Pickup at a Point Relais. Same shipping shell as home delivery: courierCodes, registerShippingMethod; packet prices are the kernel Couriers JSON page.

blocks.text: Checkout keeps the Point Relais courier only while this plugin is on. Packet prices are the kernel Couriers JSON page, not a kernel ALTER. Pair with expedition-cron for tracking.

Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-shipping-mondial-relay/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: string — public. Mondial Relay widget brand code (sandbox default BDTEST13). Change only if Mondial issued a different brand.
url — public. Connect API endpoint. Keep the sandbox host until you switch the shop to production.
secret — secret. Connect enseigne (merchant code). Fill when Mondial activates API2; leave empty to keep the stored secret.
secret — secret. Connect login. Required together with API2 password to create labels.
secret — secret. Connect password. Never shown after save; type a new value only to replace it.
url — public. SOAP WebService host used for Point Relais search and tracking. Leave the default unless Mondial gives a new endpoint.
secret — secret. WebService enseigne. Fill when you have API1 access; leave empty to keep the stored secret.
secret — secret. WebService private key used to sign API1 calls. Replace only when Mondial rotates the key.
string — public. Internal courier id for Point Relais. Keep mondial-relay-point unless you registered a different code.
string — public. Network sent to Mondial for Point Relais. Usually the same as the courier code.
string — public. Mondial delivery mode for pickup (24R). Change only if Mondial assigned another product.
string — public. How the parcel is dropped off (REL = Relais). Leave default unless Mondial tells you otherwise.
string — public. Internal courier id for home delivery. Keep mondial-relay-home unless you registered a different code.
string — public. Network sent to Mondial for home. Usually home.
string — public. Mondial delivery mode for home (HOM). Change only if Mondial assigned another product.
string — public. How a home parcel is collected (REL). Leave default unless Mondial tells you otherwise.
string — public. Name printed on the Mondial label as the shipper. Required before live expeditions.
string — public. Street and number of the ship-from address.
string — public. Postal code of the ship-from address.
string — public. City of the ship-from address.
string — public. ISO country code (FR). Must match the Mondial contract country.
string — public. Contact phone printed on the label. Use the shop number customers may call.
email — public. Contact email printed on the label. Use a mailbox you read.
url — public. Customer-facing tracking page. Keep the Mondial suivi URL unless you wrap it.
string — public. Minimum delay between tracking polls (for example 1.5s). Raise it if Mondial rate-limits you.
string — public. How long a tracking request may wait (for example 30s) before the kernel gives up.
